objective: Apply the explicit human-confirmed five core semantic policies to KU2D Core Knowledge and Learning Memory without expanding acquisition scope.
instructions: Before doing anything, verify the checked-out branch and queue authoritative_branch are exactly codex/ku2d-core-knowledge-backfill-v1; fail closed otherwise.
Read KU2D-H-000001 and treat it as the explicit Human Decision for the five candidate semantic policies from config/human_confirmation_candidate_packet.json.

Promote only those five confirmed semantic policies through the existing reviewed Learning Memory/Human Confirmation/Ground Truth mechanisms where the evidence and contracts support promotion. Do not promote unrelated candidate source observations.

For price semantics, implement the revised human policy precisely: a price on a current active official business webpage used to advertise product prices may be labelled current_advertised_price at observed_at absent contrary historical evidence; acquisition method alone never determines temporal status; known historical evidence is historical_observed_price; unresolved temporality is temporal_status_unknown; temporal status is separate from price role and does not imply transaction price, all-branch price, or variant equivalence.

Preserve the other confirmed policies: unknown counter until explicit role label; product match does not imply variant match; displayed order is not demand/rank without explicit sort semantics; environment boundary is not technique failure when the technique succeeds in an approved alternative environment.
Update taxonomy, reviewed corpus, candidate packet status, ML knowledge specifications, documentation, and deterministic tests only as required to reflect the confirmed policies.

Keep all 11 unmerged source-history observations candidate-only unless there is already merged durable repository evidence that independently satisfies promotion criteria. Do not use the Human Decision to promote source outcomes.
Do not create an ML training dataset, enable dataset export, train or run a model, perform live acquisition, expand source/domain scope, or implement Survey/Google Forms/DoE/Bias/SEM.
Re-run Core Knowledge, Learning Memory, Agent Handoff, complete deterministic corpus, regression tests, JSON/YAML parsing, compilation, and security/runtime-isolation checks.
Update Draft PR #45 with the human-confirmed policy integration. Keep the PR Draft and unmerged.
Emit KU2D-R-000006, update the coordination queue to next_action.actor=assistant, push the branch, and stop.
